notes.title: Questing 4 Autism
notes.notes:
We’re so excited to invite you to our gaming event to raise money for the Autism Society of Texas.  We’ve got a number of great indie games to play while you hang out with developers from the industry, watch some entertaining influencers and support a worthwhile cause.  

Join us Live on Twitch or in Person at the venue.  Your registration includes a chance at great giveaways from Alienware, Trader Joe's and RedTigerPro.  If you represent a group of people, sign up as a Quest Leader and get your group to join your quest to raise the most money for the Autism Society of Texas.  The Quest Group that brings in the most will receive a special prize.

Check out the website for more info:
https://runsignup.com/Race/TX/Austin/QuestingForAutism

notes.title: The Cerebral Puzzle Showcase returns!
notes.notes: That's right!  It's our second year on the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase and we're proud to once again be featured among 200+ indie puzzle games.  The Showcase starts TOMORROW!  Come check out all the great games and grab Gem Setter for a great discount.

notes.title: Happy Turkey Day!
notes.notes: Gem Setter is on sale for 30% off during the Steam Autumn Sale to celebrate the addition of the levels created by the Level Design Contest winners: ZmitteR, TheChairGuy and m31nth3c0rn3r.  Gem Setter now has over 75 official levels to challenge your brain in addition to the numerous fan made levels that you can download for hours of fun.  Enjoy the holiday season!

notes.title: Contest winner level additions.
notes.notes:
The level design contest has come to a close.  Winners have been chosen and Gem Setter will update with new levels for the Autumn Sale. 

But that doesn't mean you have to stop creating and submitting your level gems via the level editor.  We always what to see what wonderful new ideas the community can come up with!

notes.title: Gem Setter: Level Design Contest
notes.notes:
Submit a Gem Setter level of your design for a chance to be included in the official level set!  

5 Winning Levels will be chosen and each winner will be included on the official level pack for all to play and enjoy.  In addition, winners will receive early access to the new indie album by game developer and music creator 1f1n1ty.  

Submitted levels must be: 
[list]
[*]verified by you
[*]uploaded (old levels are okay!)
[*]vanilla (no hacks or glitches)
[*]thinky (ie. must contain a puzzle)
[*]unique in some way
[/list]
Don't wait!  Submit your puzzles today via this form: [url=https://t.co/0EyWwLZgbG]Submission Form[/url]

And join us on discord to stay up to speed with all updates from 1f1n1ty: [url=https://t.co/rkVDEOdZ87]Discord Link[/url]

notes.title: Summer sale going strong along with New Art!
notes.notes:
For the Summer Sale we have had new title art commissioned and we can't wait to have people try out the game for 30% off.  That's less than $5 for over 70 levels of entertainment plus hours of making levels for you and your friends.  

Come get Gem Setter now.  Before the sale ends!

notes.title: Official Steam trailer for Gem Setter is up on the store page
notes.notes:
The latest trailer for the steam release of Gem Setter has been posted to the store page and it includes some great music by 1nf1n1ty and matthewolivermusic (@matthewolivermusic on instagram).  

If you haven't yet tried this chill block slider, don't wait!  The demo is available completely FREE and once you play it, you won't be able to put it down.

notes.title: Gem Setter Demo now available!
notes.notes: The Gem Setter demo is now available.  If you're on the fence about whether or not this game is worth it, try out the first few levels and give the level editor a spin.  There is no doubt that you'll get hooked!

notes.title: Gem Setter in the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!
notes.notes: The Cerebral Puzzle Showcase kicks off on Steam at 10 AM PDT on May 19, with the page going live 30 minutes earlier for final checks. The event will run through May 23, with sales ending May 24 at 10 AM PDT.
